draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 116th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 12th of 27 at CB. He went 19th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (116th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Jourdan Lewis. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (7th percentile), 10-yard split (19th percentile). College production: 8 passes defended in 2019, 12th of 27 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 15 career games and 7 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-6 cornerback who played: 0.2% season snap share against a median of 26.1%, below the norm.
